cli.main.err_port_range: error: --port is out of range (%d). Use a value between 0 and 65535 (0 lets the OS pick a free port)
doctor.claude.config_unreadable: cannot read the config file, so there is no way to know which executable to look for
doctor.claude.remedy_install: Install Claude Code and put %s somewhere on PATH (https://claude.com/claude-code). Without it, dispatch always fails after creating the worktree and the pane.
orchestrator.confirm_startup.not_interac: Claude Code started but is not ready for input yet (agent: %s, status: %s, interactive_ready: false). Sending a prompt now would be rejected by herdr with agent_not_ready. Check the screen with `herdr agent read %s --source recent-unwrapped --lines 40`.
ratelimit.credentials.remedy_env: Set rate_limit.token_source to env in WORKFLOW.md and put the name of the environment variable holding the token in token_env (or set rate_limit.source to none to skip the rate limit).
ratelimit.credentials.remedy_keychain: On macOS the credentials live in the Keychain. Set rate_limit.token_source to keychain in WORKFLOW.md and run continuo allow-keychain-access once (or set rate_limit.source to none to skip the rate limit).
workspace.prepare.worktree_path_mismatch: the worktree was prepared but herdr opened a different location (prepared: %s / opened by herdr: %s / workspace: %s). Working in this workspace would touch the same place as another issue.
